channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Jack Hughes’ broken grin becomes enduring Olympic image
item.description: Here’s what happens when hockey players lose their teeth.

item.title: Meteorologist Belinda Jensen will retire from KARE this spring
item.description: She will leave the NBC affiliate on May 2 after more than three decades on the air.

item.title: Nick Shirley, Colin Hortman among guests of Minnesota politicians at State of the Union
item.description: The state’s 10-member congressional delegation will highlight with their guests where they stand on immigration, fraud, tariffs and political violence.

item.title: Two hockey teams, two gold medals, one presidential phone call
item.description: While inviting the men’s hockey team to State of the Union, Trump joked he might be impeached if he didn’t invite the women too.

item.title: Another Minnesota federal judge issues contempt finding over U.S. government violating immigration court orders
item.description: The judge said the Trump administration owes a man $568, the cost of his plane ticket home from immigration custody.

item.title: Minneapolis shooting leaves two dead including one teenager
item.description: The suspected shooter was believed to have been killed by police in Brooklyn Center during a shootout.

item.title: Ex-FBI agent faults state for failing to ‘hold people accountable’ for fraud
item.description: The report from Program Integrity Director Tim O’Malley comes days into a Minnesota legislative session, and many of its recommended fixes require lawmakers’ approval.

item.title: Minnesotans stuck in Puerto Vallarta describe scene in city rocked by cartel violence
item.description: Sun Country and Delta have called off flights to and from the popular Mexican tourist destination.

item.title: Former ICE instructor testifies that agents were trained to discard constitutional rights
item.description: The instructor, who is an attorney, is telling a forum sponsored by Congressional Democrats that the procedures in entering homes are not taught appropriately.

item.title: With a U.S. Senate vote looming on copper-nickel mining, this northern Minnesota town hangs in the balance
item.description: Ely remains divided between those who want mining and those who don’t believe it’s worth the risk to the Boundary Waters.
